name: HSK ~H na Imouto to Tsun na Osananajimi ni Hasamare ADV~
original_name: ＨＳＫ ～Ｈな妹とツンな幼馴染に挟まれＡＤＶ～
source:
"Stuck between imouto and osananajimi..."

For our protagonist Souichi it is a daily routine to get raised by his Imouto Hazuki, and then go to school with her and his osananajimi Kotone.

Someday, his parents suddenly had to go on a business trip for half a year.
While Hazuki was made to go shopping, his parents told him that she is in fact not his real imouto -- that they don't have any connection by blood.

Hazuki was secretly peeking at this scene.

After she learned that there is no blood-connection between them, she approached her beloved brother.

Kotone noticed that, and in order to keep Souichi's desire away from his little sister, she had sex with him...

And thus his H-days began -- stuck between his proactive-perverted imouto, and his osananajimi, who tried to keep them from doing "it".

[Mostly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=672486]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
“被困在imouto和osananajimi之间……”

对于我们的主人公宗一来说，由他的叶月妹妹抚养长大，然后和她以及他的小七味琴音一起上学是他们的日常生活。

有一天，他的父母突然要出差半年。
当叶月被迫去购物时，他的父母告诉他，她实际上不是他真正的妹妹——他们没有任何血缘关系。

叶月偷偷地看着这一幕。

当她得知他们之间没有血缘关系后，她接近了她深爱的哥哥。

琴音注意到了这一点，为了让宗一的欲望远离妹妹，她与他发生了性关系……

就这样，他的快乐时光开始了——夹在积极主动的变态妹妹和试图阻止他们做“这件事”的奥萨那纳吉米之间。

[大部分翻译自 [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=672486]Getchu[/url]]
